reuse.why: It hooks into the existing pre-link guard in accounts/link.ts that all six provider link functions already call.

duplication.why: The closed check is written once and duplicates nothing.

placement.why: The closed-account rule is appended to assertBankAccountNotLinked, a helper named and parameterised for the one-link-per-bank-account rule, so two distinct rules hide behind one misleading name.

scope.why: The change is one guard plus three focused tests.

maintainability.why: Every path is covered, but the rule is hard to discover from the function name; a separate assertAccountLinkable or a rename would be clearer.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The rule goes through the shared guard called by every link handler.

one_place.where: accounts/link.ts assertBankAccountNotLinked now checks upgradingId's closed flag, and all six provider link functions in app.ts call it before any write.
